text.body:
pramāṇavarttikasvavrittiṭīkā yo vidhvastasamastabandhanagatissamyag vaśitve sthitaḥ , sarvvajñeyavisārinirmmalatamajñānaprabandhodayaḥ sattvārthodyatamānasaśca suciraṃ śrīmañjunātho vibhuḥ , tannatvā bahuśodya vārttikagataṃ kiñcidvivakṣāmyahaṃ ṭīkākṛtaḥ sakala eva guṇaḥ sa eṣa brūtetra vastugahanepi yadasmadādiḥ dignāgadantamusa lairviṣame'panīte labdheṣu vartmasu sukhaṃ kalabhāḥ prayānti yo māmavajñāyati kopi guṇābhimānī jānātyasau kimapi taṃ prati naiṣa yatnaḥ A parody of Bhavabhūti's Malatimādhavam 1:4. kaścid bhaviṣyati kadācidanena cārthī nānādhiyāñjagati janmavatāṃ hi nāntaḥ yadyapi hi śāstrārambhe namaskāraślokopanyāsamantareṇa kāyavāṅamanobhiriṣṭadevatānamaskārakaraṇena puṇyopacayādavighnena śāstrasya parisamāptirbhavati tathāpi vyākhyātṛśrotṝṇāṃ stutipurassarayā pravṛttyā puṇyātiśayotpādāt pārārthyaṃ sadācārānupālanaṃ cālocya viśiṣṭadevatāpūjāślokamupanyastavānācāryaḥ vidhūtakalpanetyādi yadā samantabhadraśabdo rūḍhyā bodhisattvavṛtto na gṛhyate tadeyaṃ buddhasya bhagavataḥ pūjā sā ca dvidhā stotrataḥ praṇāmataśca namaḥśabdena praṇāmataḥ pariśiṣṭaiḥ stotrataḥ stotramapi svārthasampattitaḥ parārthasampattitaḥ parārthasaṃpadupāyataśca tridhā svārthasampannaśca parārthaṃprati samartho bhavatīvi this notes belog the the base text, which was not keyboarded

prathamaṃ pūrvvārddhena svārthasampaduktā svārthasampacca kāyatrayalakṣaṇā tribhirvviśeṣairvviśiṣṭodbhāvitā āvaraṇaprahāṇaviśeṣeṇa gāmbhīryaviśeṣeṇa audāryaviśeṣeṇa ca tatrātmātmīyādyākārapravṛttā grāhyagrāhakākārapravṛttāśca traidhātukāścittacaittāḥ kalpanā saiva jālambandhanātmakatvāt tadvidhūtaṃ vidhvastaṃ savāsanaṃ punaranutpattidharmatvamāpāditaṃ yāsāṃ mūrttīnāntāstathoktāḥ etenāvaraṇaprahāṇaviśeṣa uktaḥ gāmbhīryaudāryaviśeṣau tu gambhīrodārapadābhyāmuktau vidhūtakalpanājālā gambhīrāḥ śrāvakapratyekabuddhādyaviṣayatvāt udārāssakalajñeyasakalasatvārthavyāpanāt mūrttayastrayaḥ kāyāḥ svābhāvikasāmbhogikanairmāṇikā yasya bhagavataḥ asau vidhūtakalpanājālagambhīrodāramūrttiḥ bhadraṃ kalyāṇamabhyudayaniḥśreyasalakṣaṇaṃ tat samantānniravaśeṣantadarthināṃ yathā bhavyambhavati yasmāt sakāśādasau samantabhadraḥ etena parārthasampaduktā asyāśca parārthasampadaḥ samantasphuraṇatviṣa ityanena siddhyupāya uktaḥ tviṣo raśmaya iha tu yathāvasthitavastugrahaṇa evaṃ sādharmyeṇa dharmadeśanā abhyudayaniḥśreyasasādhanaviṣayāstviṣa iva tviṣa ucyante samanto niravaśeṣaḥ parārthasādhanopāyaḥ spharyate vyāpyate vinayebhyaḥ sākalyena kathanāt yābhistāḥ samantaspharaṇyastatratathābhūtāstviṣo dharmadeśanā yasya sa samantaspharaṇatviṭ namaḥ śabdayogācca sarvvatra caturthī yadā tu rūḍhirapekṣyate tadāyaṃ samantabhadraśa bdo mahāyāne bodhisatvaviśeṣe rūḍha iti bodhisatvasyeyaṃ pūjā padārthastu pūrvvavad yojyaḥ ayantu viśeṣo vidhūtakalpanājālatvaṃ bodhisatvabhūmyāvaraṇaprahāṇato draṣṭavyaṃ gāmbhīryaṃ śrāvakapratyekabuddhapṛthagjanāviṣayatvataḥ audāryantu bodhisatvamā hātmataḥ kāyatrayamapyanurūpaṃ bodhisatvānāṃ vidyata eva prakarṣagamanāttu buddhānāṃ vyavasthāpyata iti Missing portion is found in the margin in a different hand. tatsāmarthyakurvadrūpatāsyāpi bhāvitvāt tasmāt pūrvānubhūtārthakriyāsādhanavastusādharmyāt pratyakṣeṣvapi vastuṣvanāgataphalayogyatāniścayo na pratyakṣatastenānumānādevārthānarthavivecanamiti tadapyayuktaṃ yato yadi sā yogyatā kurvadrūpatā rtheṣu varttamānakālabhāvinī tadābhyāsātiśayavatāpi pratyakṣeṇa niścīyeta liṅgavat athānāgataiva sā tadānumānenāpinaniścīyetānāgaterthenumānābhāvāditi vakṣyati etena yaducyate pravṛttiviṣayavastuprāpaṇaṃ pratyakṣānumānayoraviśiṣṭami ti tadapi nirastaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ anāgatārthakriyāsamartho hi pravṛttiviṣayo na ca tatsāmarthyaṃ pratyakṣānumānābhyāṃ niścīyata ityuktaṃ paricchinnaśca pravṛttiviṣaya iṣyate na ca santānaḥ pratyakṣādikṣaṇena paricchinnastatkathaṃ pravṛttiviṣayaḥ athaikasmin kṣaṇe pratyakṣaṃ pravṛttamapi niścayavaśāt kṣaṇasāmānyaviṣayatvenaikasantativiṣayantadayuktaṃ pratibhāsamānenaiva hi viṣayeṇa niścayavaśāt pratyakṣaṃ sāmānyaviṣayaṃ vyavasthāpyate na paramārthataḥ svalakṣaṇaviṣayatvāt yathā liṃgaviṣayaṃ pratyakṣaṃ tathā hi pratibhāsamānamidaṃ dhūmasvalakṣaṇantārṇṇamvā pārṇṇamvānyadvā sambhavati tatra ca viśeṣānavadhāraṇena kṣaṇamātraniścayena ca svalakṣaṇaviṣayamapi sāmānyaviṣayaṃ pratyakṣaṃ vyavasthāpyate pratyakṣapṛṣṭhabhāvino niścayasya pratyakṣaviṣayānusāritvāt na punarekakṣaṇaviṣayampratyakṣamevaṃ vyavasthāpayituṃ śakyate yato yaḥ pratyakṣe pratibhāsate kṣaṇo nāsau niścito nāpi pūrvakṣaṇarūpo parakṣaṇarūpo vā sambhavati bhinnakālatvāt tat kathantatra viśeṣānavadhāraṇena kṣaṇamātraniścayena ca kṣaṇasāmānyaviṣayaṃ pratyakṣaṃ vyavasthāpyeta pratyakṣapṛṣṭhabhāvinaḥ sa evāyamiti niścayasya sāmānyaviṣayatvepi na santānaviṣayatvaṃ pratipannapratīyamānayorviṣayīkaraṇenānāgatakṣaṇāniścayād vijātīyavyāvṛttarūpaviṣayatvāccāta eva kṣaṇasya pratibhāsepyayaṃ ghaṭa iti jñāpananiścayaḥ nanu yadyarthakriyāsamartho vastusantānonapratyakṣānumānābhyāṃ paricchidyate kathantarhi tayoḥ pravarttakatvam vastusvarūpamātraparicchedāditi brūmaḥ tathā hyagnyādikamvastvekatra prabandhavṛttyā dāhādyarthakriyāsamarthaṃ pratyakṣeṇa niścinvannanyatrāpi deśādāvetadupalabhyamānaṃ prabandhavṛttyaivedṛgvidhārthakārīti niścāyayati sa eva punaḥ kālāntare phalārthī tatsvarūpamparyeṣamāṇognyādikaṃ pratyakṣānumānābhyāṃ dṛṣṭvā tadevedamiti niścayapūrvvakaṃ pravarttate tenāyamarthastatsvarūpamātraparicchede pramāṇavyāpāro na prabandhavṛttiparicchede nāpyarthakriyāsāmarthyaparicchede pūrvamevāsya sarvasya paricchinnatvāt tena pratyakṣānumānayoḥ pravarttakattvaṃ yuktameva kathantarhyarthānarthavivecanasyānumānāśrayatvamuktam ... ... ... ... ... ... ta naivātrārthā nābhipretamapi tu caturāryasatyaṃ yato muktyarthino vayaṃ muktiśca caturāryasatyadarśanād bhavatīti bhagavatoktaṃ taddarśanañca bhāvanābhyāsato niṣpadyate bhāvanāyāṃ pravṛttiśca caturāryasatyaniścayena tanniścayaśca parokṣatvādanumānādeva bhavatītyarthānarthavivecanāśrayatvamanumānasyaiva artho nirodhamārgāvupādeyatvādanartho duḥkhasamudayau tyājyatvāt yadvārthaḥ paramārthasatyamanarthaḥ saṃvṛttisatyaṃ tayoryad vivecanaṃ svarūpeṇa vyavasthāpanantasyānumānāśrayatvāt arthānarthavivecanakāri ca sarvaṃ jñānaṃ na svalakṣaṇaṃ gṛhṇātyapi tvadhyavasyatīti bhrāntameva tena yadi śabdaniṣpateḥ kathantacchaktiḥ rāgaśaktirvacanaṃpratyupayujyate atha tālvādivyāpārakāle rāgaśakterapi vacanampratyupayoga iṣyate tataścādyavarṇṇaniṣpattikāle rāgasyāpi niṣpattirekasāmagryadhīnatvāt rāgasyānupayoge vacanaṃprati kathaṃ tacchaktī rāgaśaktirvāsanākhyātmātmīyābhiniveśalakṣaṇā vacanampratyupayujyate vīta rāgāṇāmātmādyabhiniveśasyābhāvāt śaktyupayoge hi vacanaṃ prati sa eva rāga upayuktaḥ syādātmādyabhiniveśavatāṃ sarveṣāmeva rāgitvāt tacca rāgasya vacanaṃpratyupayogitvannāstītyuktaṃ vaktukāmatā sāmānyahetutvādityatrāntare tasmādityādi nigamanaṃ nāntarīyakameveti sarvajñeyavyāpi jñānaṃ etadevāha sarvadarśana ityādi kimpunaradarśanamātrānnābhāvaniścaya ityāha kvacittathetyādi tena prakāreṇa dṛṣṭānāṃ prāk punardeśakālasaṃskārabhedeneti bhedaśabdasya pratyekaṃ sambandhaḥ saṃskāraḥ kṣīrāvasekādiḥ pūrvadṛṣṭaprakārādanyathā syāt kimivetyāha yathāmalakya iti saṃskārabhedasyaitadudāharaṇanna caivambahulamiti na madhuraphalā bahulandṛśyante kaṣāyaphalānāṃ bāhulyena darśanāt na cedānīṃ bahulaṃ madhuraphalānāmadarśanāt kvacitsambhavino madhuraphalasya pratikṣepaḥ tathā deśabhedena piṇḍakharjjūrasya sambhavaḥ kālabhedena puṣpādeḥ āmalakīdṛṣṭāntena caitadāha yathāmalakyaḥ kṣīrādisaṃskārādanyathā bhavanti tathā rāgādiyogyaścittasantānastattvābhyāsābhisaṃskārād yogyo bhavati abhyāsācca nairātmyālambanameva vijñānaṃ spaṣṭābhamvairā- rāgyamucyate nairātmyadarśanādātmādyabhiniveśavigamena rāgādyanutpatteḥ sarvadharmakṣaṇikatvādyālambanaṃ ca jñānaṃ spaṣṭābhaṃ sarvajñatvaṃ cocyate sarvājñānavigamāt tasmāt tattvābhyāsanimittā sphuṭābhatvabṛddhireva tattvasākṣātkaraṇena pratyakṣatvakāriṇī rāgādiyogyasvabhāvatāṃ jñānasya bādhate tataścānyathādṛṣṭamapi hetubalādanyathā bhavedapi tena yadi nāma rāgārahite kvacid vacanaṃ na dṛṣṭantāvatā sarvatra vītarāge vacanena na bhāvyamiti nāsti niścayaḥ tataścāniścitavyatirekād vacanamātrānna rāgadyanumānaṃ yata evantena kāraṇenaitadyuktamvaktuṃ mādṛśo vaktā yohamivāyoniśomanaskārān tadevāha rāgotpattītyādi kaḥ punarasāvityāha ātmetyādi ātmadarśanaṃ sa tkā ya dṛ ṣṭiḥ nityasukhādiviparyāso'yoniśo manaskāraḥ dvandvasamāsaścāyaṃ ātmadarśanamevāyoniśomanaskāra iti viśeṣaṇa samāsovā tadeti mādṛśo vakteti viśeṣaṇepyapārthako vacanodāhāraḥ vacanādityasya hetorudāharaṇamanarthakamityarthaḥ tadā hi yo mādṛśo rāgotpattipratyayaviśeṣeṇa yuktaḥ sa rāgī yathāhamityayameva hetuḥ syāt yata evamadarśanamātrānnāsti niścayastasmād vipakṣe'dṛṣṭirvipakṣe hetoradarśanamaheturliṅgasya vyatirekaniścayaṃ prati syānmatiḥ vipakṣadṛṣṭyā hetorvyabhicāro na ca vītarāge vacanaṃ dṛṣṭantasmādadarśanāt sādhyābhāve vyatirekaḥ siddha ityata āha na cādarśanamātreṇeti vipakṣe hetoravyabhicāritā kasmāt mambhāvyavyabhicāratvāt sambhāvyo vyabhicāro yasya sa tathā tadbhāvastasmāt yadyapi na dṛṣṭo vipakṣe tathāpi tatra sambhavo na viruddha iti saṃmbhāvyate vyabhicāraḥ sthālyantargatāstaṇḍulāḥ sthālītaṇḍulāsteṣāṃ pākavat etameva dṛṣṭāntaṃ samarthayitumāha na hītyādi bāhulyena sthālyantargatānāṃ pakvānāndarśanepi na sthālyantargatatvena kevalena pākaḥ sidhyati mātragrahaṇantu viśeṣanirāsārthaṃ yad vakṣyatyevantu syāditi kuto'siddhirvyabhicārasya darśanāt evaṃsvabhāvā iti ye pakvā dṛṣṭāstaistulyasvabhāvāḥ etaireva pakvaiḥ samānaḥ pākaheturyeṣānte pakvā iti anyathā tvityasatye-tasmin viśeṣaṇe śeṣostīti śeṣavadanirṇṇīto viṣayostīti yāvat tacca vyabhicāri kinnai yā yi ko ktaṃ kāryāt kāraṇānumānarūpaṃ śeṣavadanumānamihābhipretamutā nyadeveti pṛcchati kiṃpunarityādi śeṣavatsvarūpamāha yasyetyādi yasya hetoradarśanamātreṇāpramāṇakena vipakṣavyatirekaḥ prasādhyate tasya hetoḥ saṃśayahetutvāt saṃśayakāritvāccheṣavattadanumānamudāhṛtaṃ kiṅkāraṇantasya hetoḥ sa vyatireko'niścita iti vipakṣepi vṛttirāśaṃkyeta kiṃpunarna niścita ityāha vyatireketyādi anupalambhepi kathaṃ saṃśaya ityāha na sarvetyādi dṛśyānupalabdhireva na gamikā yata evannādarśanamātrād vyatirekastasmādekanivṛttyā sādhyanivṛttyānyanivṛttiṃsādhananivṛttimicchatā tayoḥ sādhyasādhanayoḥ kaścit svabhāvena pratibandhastādātmyatadutpattilakṣaṇopyeṣṭavyaḥ na kevalamadṛṣṭimātraṃ anyathā pratibandhāniṣṭāvagamako hetuḥ syāt vyāpteraniścitatvāt yata evantena kāraṇena hetostriṣvapi rūpeṣu pakṣadharmānvayavyatirekeṣu niścayo varṇṇitaḥ ācārya di gnā ge na pra mā ṇa sa mu cca yā diṣu asiddhastu dvayorapi sādhanamityādinā kasya nirāsenetyāha asiddhetyādi ādyāditvāt tṛtīyārthe tasi vipakṣeṇetyarthaḥ tatrāsiddhavipakṣeṇa pakṣadharmatvaniścayo varṇṇitaḥ viparotārthāviruddhastasya vipakṣeṇānvayaniścayaḥ vyabhicāryanaikāntikastasya vipakṣeṇa vyatirekaniścayaḥ anvayavyatirekaniścayaṃ ca varṇṇayatā pratibandhopyarthato darśita eva yasmānna hyasati pratibandhe'nvayavyatirekaniścayosti tena kāraṇena tameva tādātmyatadutpattilakṣaṇaṃ pratibandhandarśayannākṣipanniścayamāha yasya doṣasya nirāśe na yo niścaya uktastaṃ vyācaṣṭe tatretyādi viruddhatatpakṣyāṇāmiti viruddhānāṃ viruddhapakṣyāṇāṃ ca viruddhapakṣyā yeṣāṃ sattvaṃ vipakṣe niścitaṃ sapakṣasattvaṃ sandigdhaṃ sandigdhānaikāntikā evaite paraprasiddhyā tvevamabhidhānaṃ vyatirekasyāniścayeneti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ anaikāntikasya nirāsa iti sambandhaḥ tenāyamarthaḥ sādhāraṇānaikāntikasyeti tatpakṣasya ca anaikāntikapakṣasya ca śeṣavadādeḥ ādiśabdāt sapakṣavipakṣayossandigdhasya nirāsaḥ yasya sapakṣasattvaṃ vipakṣe cādarśanamātrād vyatirekastaccheṣavat prasiddhastu dvayorityā cā rya granthamidānīṃ vyācaṣṭe dvayorityādi dvayorityanenaikasya vādinaḥ prativādino vā yaḥ siddhastasyapratiṣedhaḥ prasiddhavacanena sandigdhayoḥ śeṣavadasādhāraṇayoḥ pratiṣedha iti sambandhaḥ kva sandigdhayorityāha sapakṣavipakṣayorapīti śeṣavato'sapakṣasandehaḥ asādhāraṇasya tu sapakṣavipakṣayoḥ tasmānniścayavacanādā cā rye ṇā pi pratibandha iṣṭa eva anyathā'sati pratibandhe sādhyasādhanayoḥ vipakṣe'darśanamātreṇa vyatireke ācāryeṇeṣyamāṇe vyabhicārivipakṣeṇānaikāntikapratipakṣeṇa vaidharmyavacanaṃ ca yat pratijñātantadapārthakamityākūtaṃ kva punarācāryeṇaṃ pratijñātamityāha yadetyādi nyā ya mu khe caitaduktaṃ yadubhayaṃ vaktavyamiti sādharmyaṃ vaidharmyaṃ ca kasya pratipakṣeṇa kimuktamityāha viruddhetyādi sādhanasya vacanaṃ viruddhapratipakṣeṇa vaidharmyavacanamanaikāntikapratipakṣeṇa yadyadṛṣṭiphalantacca adarśanamātraphalantacceti vaidharmyavacanaṃ etadeva vyācaṣṭe yadītyādi teneti vaidharmyavacanena vipakṣe hetoradarśanaṃ khyāpyate tadityadarśanamanuktepi vaidharmye gamyate darśanābhāvalakṣaṇasyādarśanasya vaidharmyavacanāt prāgapi siddhatvāt tasmādapārthakamvaidharmyavacanaṃ hetordarśanabhrāntirvipakṣesti tannivṛtyarthamvaidharmyavacanamiti cedāha na hītyādi tasyeti pratipādyasya vaidharmyavacanāt prāk hetorvipakṣe darśanabhrāntirasti yā vaidharmyavacanena nivarttyate tasmādetad yathā sapakṣe hetordarśane na bhrāntiḥ kintu tadvismṛtamiti sādharmyavacanena smaryate tathā smṛtirvācā vaidharmyavacanenādarśane kriyata iti cet dṛṣṭāntameva vighaṭayitumāha darśanamityādi darśanamapratīyamānamasmaryamāṇaṃ na sādhyapratipattyaṅgamiti yuktantatreti darśane vācā smaraṇādhānaṃ smṛtijananaṃ adarśanārthantu na yuktaṃ yasmādadarśanantu darśanābhāvo hetorvipakṣe sa darśanena bādhyate tadabhāve vipakṣadarśanābhāve siddha eva darśanābhāva ityapārthakantatsiddhaye darśanābhāvasiddhaye vaidharmyavacanaṃ ayamabhiprāyo darśanamparokṣatvād vismaryeteti tatsmaraṇārthamvacanaṃ yuktaṃ darśanābhāvastu darśananivṛttirūpaḥ sa ca darśanānubhavābhāvādeva pratibhāsate pratibhāsamānasya ca kiṃ smaraṇena tatsiddhaye'pārthakamvacanaṃ na vai anupalabhamānasya puṃsastāvatetyadarśanamātreṇa vipakṣe heturnāstītyevaṃ niścayo bhavati deśādiviprakṛṣṭānāmanupalambhepi sattvāt tadarthannāstīti niścayotpādanārthamvaidharmyavacanamiti cettanna yasmānna ca nāstīti vacanādapramāṇakāt tatpratikṣipyamāṇaṃ nāstyeva kathantarhi nāstīti gamyata ityāha yathetyādi etaduktambhavati hetoḥ svasādhye pratibandhagrāhakameva pramāṇaṃ sādhyāyattatāgrāhakantacceha darśanamabhipretaṃ yacca sādhya eva hetordarśanamidameva sarvatra vipakṣe'darśanaṃ tena yasya sādhyasādhanayoḥ pratibandhagrāhakaṃ darśanaṃ pravṛttamvismṛtaṃ ca tasyaiva puṃsaḥ darśanādarśanayoḥ pratītayoḥ sādharmyavaidharmyavacanābhyāṃ smaraṇaṃ kriyate nānyasyetyarthaḥ yadāha pramāṇaṃ dṛṣṭāntābhyāmupadarśyata iti yathā yadi nāsti sa khyāpyata iti yathā yena prakāreṇa svasādhyapratibandhena vipakṣe heturnāsti yadi sa nyāya iti pratibandhagrāhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ khyāpyate smaryate tadā nāstīti gamyate na tu pratibandhamantareṇa yadītyādi prathamaṃ kārikābhāgamāha yadyanupalabhamānonupalambhamātrānnāstīti na pratyeti tadā vaidharmyavacanādapyapramāṇakānna pratyeṣyati yasmāttadapi vaidharmyavacanaṃ tvatā tenānupalambhameva khyāpayati nādhikamviśeṣaṃ syānmataṃ sādhyābhāvakṛto hetvabhāvo vaidharmyavacanena khyāpyate tatosti viśeṣa ityata āha na caiketyādi ekānupalambha iti sādhyānupalambhaḥ anyābhāvaṃ sādhanābhāvaṃ asati pratibandha iti bhāvaḥ atiprasaṃgāditi pratibandhamantareṇa nivṛttau gonivṛttyāpyaśvasya niyamena nivṛttiḥ syāt atha matam ācāryadi gnā ge na vipakṣe heturnnāstī tyuktamata eva niścaya ityata āha na cetyādi tenā cā rye ṇa nāstīti yad vaidharmyavacanaṃ kṛtaṃ tasmāttathā bhavati vastuno nāstitvameva bhavatyatiprasaṅgāt tadvacanasya hi prāmāṇye pratijñāmātrādapi sādhyasiddhiḥ syāt taditi tasmāt kathamvaidharmyavacanenānaikāntikaparihāraḥ naiva tasmād vipakṣāddhetorvyāvṛttimicchatā tatra vyāvṛttau nyāyo vaktavyaḥ sādhyasādhanayoḥ pratibandhagrāhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ yata iti nyāyāt asyeti pratipādyasya sādhanaṃ vyāvṛttimiti niścayo bhavati nanvityādi paraḥ tadabhāve sādhyābhāve'nupalambhātasiddhā vyāvṛttirhetorayameva nyāya iti manyate yadyadṛṣṭyā hetorvipakṣānnivṛttiḥ syāttadā śeṣavadanumānaṃ vyabhicāri kiṃ naiva vyabhicāri syāt kīdṛśaṃ punastadityāha yathetyādi etāni phalānītyupayuktādanyāni ayaṃ ca dharminirddeśaḥ pakvānyevaṃ rasāni ceti sādhyadharmaḥ evaṃ-rasāni madhurāṇyamlāni vā rūpāviśeṣāditi hetuḥ upayuktasya phalasya yadrūpaṃ raktatādi tena tulyatvāt ekaśākhāprabhavādveti hetuḥ upayuktavaditi dṛṣṭāntaḥ kasmādadarśanamātrād vyatireka iṣyamāṇe śeṣavatovyabhicāritvaṃ syādityāha atrāpītyādi atra śeṣavadanumāne vivakṣitaṃ rūpaviśeṣādiyuktamupabhuktādanyatphalantasyāśeṣasya pakṣīkaraṇe heto rūpādiśeṣādikasya sādhyābhāvenupalaṃbhostīti vipakṣāvyāvṛttirataścāvyabhicāritā syāt tathā hi yat pakṣīkṛtaṃ phalaṃ yaccopayuktaṃ sapakṣatvenopāttantadvyatirekeṇa vipakṣabhūte tṛtīye rāśau nāsti yathoktasya hetorvṛttiḥ pratyakṣabādhetyādi kadācidekaśākhāprabhavasyāpi phalasyāpakvasyātadrasasya vā pratyakṣeṇānubhavasambhavāt pratyakṣabādhāśaṅkā eva śeṣavato vyabhicāra ityeke ī śva ra se na prabhṛtayaḥ tadayamartho na kevalābhyāmanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ heturgamakaḥ, api tvabādhitaviṣayatve satīti netyādinā pariharati pakṣīkṛto yoviṣayaḥ parokṣastatra pratyakṣabādhāyā abhāvāt na pravṛttena pratyakṣeṇa bādhāśaṅkā kintu kadācid gandhapratyakṣabādhāpakṣaṃ iti cedāha tathetyādi tathā kadācit pratyakṣabādhā bhavedityāśaṅkāyāmatiprasaṃgaḥ yasmādanyatrābhimate hetau pratyakṣabādhāyā abhāvaniyamābhāvāt na hi sambandhābhyupagame parasya bādhāśaṅkā nivarttata iti bhāvaḥ tasmāt pratibandhānabhyupagamavādinā vṛttaṃ pramāṇaṃ bādhakameṣṭavyaṃ avṛttabādhane'pravṛttenaiva pramāṇena bādhane sarvatrānāśvāsaḥ sarvatra hetau na syādāśvāso gamakatvaniścayaḥ bādhakasya śaṃkyamānatvāt naivaṃ pratibandhavādinaḥ sarvatra hetāvanāśvāsaḥ sādhyapratibaddhe hetau bādhāśaṃkāyā apyabhāvāt hetuprayogāttu pūrvaṃ syād sādhyābhāve hetorvyatireke sati sattāmātreṇa vyatireko gamakaḥ syādityata āha vyatirekastvityādi hetoryo vipakṣād vyatirekaḥ sa siddha eva niścita eva sādhanaṃ iti hetostathābhāvaniścayaṃ sādhyābhāve yo hetvabhāvastanniścayamapekṣate etadāha nāsmākambhavatāmiva darśanābhāvamātrād vyatirekaḥ kintu sādhyasādhanayoḥ sati pratibandhe sādhyābhāve hetorvipakṣādvyāvṛttatvaṃ svagato dharmaḥ hetośca yadrūpantadavaśyaṃ svaniścayamapekṣate jñāpakatvāditi kathaṃ tvanmatena śeṣavato vyabhicāritvamiti cedāha anupalambhāttvityādi kvacidvipakṣaikadeśe hetorabhāvasiddhāvapyapratibaddhasya hetoḥ sādhye syāt kīdṛśaṃ nedaṃ nirātmakamityādi prasaṅgamukhena cedamuktamaprāṇādimattvaprasaṅgāt prāṇādimatvācca sātmakaṃ ayaṃ ca hetuḥ sātmake kvacinna dṛṣṭonirātmakebhyaśca vyāvṛtta iti sādhyanivṛttau paricchinattyataḥ sattāmātrasyaiva grāhakaṃ pratyakṣamiti taduktaṃ ma ṇḍa ne na āhurvidhātṛ pratyakṣaṃ na niṣeddhya vipaścitaḥ naikatva āgamastena pratyakṣeṇa virudhyata iti tadetadubhayamapyayuktaṃ sattāmātrasyāpratibhāsanāt gavāśvādīnāṃ svasvarūpeṇaiva pratibhāsanāt taduktaṃ tattvayuktampratidravyaṃ bhinnarūpopalambhanāt na hyākhyātumaśakyatvād bhedo nāstīti gamyata iti yopyāha bhāvānāmbheda eva nāsti tathā hi goraśvānutpāde yādṛśaṃ svarūpamaśvotpādepi tādṛśameva nāparamadhikaṃ kiñcijjātamiti kathamato bhedaḥ bhavatu vā bhedo nāsau pratyakṣagrāhyo'smādayambhinna iti evaṃrūpasya vyāpārasya pratyakṣe'bhāvāt yadāha na hīdamiyato vyāpārān karttuṃ samarthamiti sopi nirastaḥ gavāśvādīnāṃ svasvarūpeṇotpattireva bhedaḥ te ca svasvarūpeṇa pratyakṣevabhāsante tathāvabhāsaśca loke bhedāvabhāsa iti yatkiñcidetat tasmāt purovasthiteṣu svasvabhāvavyavasthiterityasya hetoḥ pratyakṣeṇa bhedaṃ pratipadyamānaḥ sarvopasaṃhāreṇa pratipadyate'taḥ sarvabhāvā vyāvṛttibhāgina iti vyāptigrahaṇapramāṇaphalamiti yataśca jātyādayorthāntarabhūtā na santīti pratipādayiṣyate ataḥ pāramārthiko dharmadharmibhāvo nāstītyuktambhavati nanu sāmānyayogāt sajātīyā ucyante yadi ca sāmānyannāsti kathaṃ sajātīyād vyāvṛttirityucyate naitadasti na samānānāmutpannānāmbhāvānāṃ sāmānyayogāt samānarūpatā svahetubhya eva tathāniṣpannatvāt tena yadu dyo ta ka re ṇo cyate na gavi gotvaṃ yena gotvayogāt prāg gaurevāsāviti vyarthaṃ gotvaṃ syād api tu yadaiva vastu tadaiva gotvenābhisambadhyate gotvayogāttu prāg vastu na vidyate na cāvidyamānaṅ gauriti vā'gauriti vā śakyaṃ vyapadeṣṭumiti tannirastaṃ yadaiva vastu tadaiva tasya gorūpatayā niṣpannatvāt kiṃ gotvayogena nāpyasamānānāṃ sāmānyayogāt samānarūpatā teṣāṃ sāmānyasyaivābhāvāt samānānāṃ ca bhāvaḥ sāmānyamityabhyupagamyate sāmānyācca samānarūpatve bhāvānāmabhyupagamyamāne yāvanna sāmānyayogastāvanna samānā bhāvāḥ yāvacca na samānāstāvanna sāmānyayoga ityanyonyāśrayatvaṃ syāt tasmāt svahetubhya eva samānā utpannāḥ tena śāvaleyācca bhinnatvaṃ bāhuleyāśvayossamaṃ sāmānyaṃ nānyadiṣṭaṃ cet kvāgopohaḥ prakalpyatāmiti nirastaṃ sāmānyeṣvevāgopohaprakalpanāt asamānānāṃ cāpohyātmatayā prakalpanāt yadapyuccate samānā iti pratibhāsādeva nirvikalpake jñāne sāmānyapratibhāsonyathā bāhuleyāśvavat śāvaleyabāhuleyayorapi vailakṣaṇyapratītiḥ syāt sarvātmanā bhedād bhavati ca samānā iti pratītistasmādasyaiva sāmānyamiti taduktaṃ nirvikalpakabodhena dvyātmakasya vastuno grahaṇamiti yadvā savikalpake na cet sāmānyaṃ gṛhyate nirvikalpakenāpi gṛhītameva savikalpā bhinnapratibhāsatvāt tathā hi ya eva śāvaleyādayo gauriti jñānena gṛhyante ta eva nirvikalpake jñāne pratibhāsante kevalamekantānavikalpya gṛhṇātyanyad vikalpyeti tayoḥ svarūpabhedo na pratibhāsabhedaḥ tasmānnirvikalpakepi jñāne sāmānyaṃ pratibhāsata iti tadapi nirastaṃ svahetubhya eva keṣāñcit samānānāṃ pratibhāsanāt sāmānyasya ca vyaktiparatantraṃ svarūpaṃ na ca nirvikalpakaṃ jñānaṃ pāratantryamvastuno gṛhṇāti svātantryeṇa vastugrāhitvāt tatkathaṃ sāmānyagrāhakamucyate anugatasya ca rūpasya pratyekavad yugapad bahuṣvapratibhāsanāt ata eva vikalpaḥ samāneṣvekāntabhinneṣu nirvikalpakapratyakṣabādhitamanugatākāraṃ gṛhṇan bhrānto bhavati nirvikalpakagṛhītasāmānyagrāhī vā'pramāṇaṃ syād gṛhītagrāhitvāt atha vikalpya grāhitvād agṛhītagrāhitvaṃ smṛtyāderapitarhi smaryamāṇaviṣayatā gṛhītagrāhitvanna syāt atha jātyādiviśiṣṭavastugrāhitayā vikalpasyāgṛhītagrāhitvamevamapi yadi jātyādiviśiṣṭatvamvastunaḥ pāramārthiko dharmastadā nirvikalpakenāpi gṛhītameveti kathamagṛhītagrāhitvam atha kalpikastadā tadgrāhakasya kathaṃ prāmāṇyamāropitārthatvāt tasmānnāstyeva jātyādiriti sthitaṃ kathantarhi bhāvā vyāvṛttibhāgina ityucyante kalpitadharmadvāreṇāyaṃ vyapadeśa ityadoṣaḥ ataḥ agonivṛttiḥ sāmānyaṃ vācyaṃ yaiḥ parikalpyate gotvavastveva tairuktamagopohagirā sphuṭamiti Ślokavārtika. Apohavāda. nirastaṃ pāramārthikasya gotvasya niṣedhaḥ kriyate na tu kalpitasyeti vakṣyati yadi paramārthiko dharmadharmibhāvo nāsti kathantarhi kṛtakaḥ śabdo nitya iti buddhīnāmbhedaḥ śabdaikasvarūpaviṣayatvāt atha nirviṣayā etā vāsanābījamātrataḥ pratipattiḥ pravṛttiśca bāhyertheṣu kathambhavet atha bāhyādhyavasāyāt pravṛttirevamapi kṛtakatvasya yovasāyaḥ sa evānityasyābhedāditi kathambuddhibhedaḥ kṛtakānityayorabhedādeva tadanubhavāhitavāsanābhedasyābhāvānna tattvato buddhibheda ityatrāha yasmādityādi yasmāt sarvasmāt sarvabhāvā vyāvṛttāstasmād yato yato nityākṛtakādeḥ śabdādīnāmarthānāṃ vyāvṛttistannibandhanāḥ vyāvṛttyāvadhivyā vṛttinibandhanā dharmabhedā anityakṛtakādayaḥ kalpyante vikalpairāropyante kimviśiṣṭāstadviśeṣāvagāhinaḥ tasya svalakṣaṇasya ye viśeṣā akṛtakādivyāvṛttirūpalakṣaṇāstadavagāhinaḥ tadavagāhanaśīlāstadabhedāvabhāsanaśīlā ityarthaḥ etaduktambhavati akṛtako na bhavatītyanena dvāreṇa prabodhitāyā eva kṛtakavikalpavāsanāyā eṣā prakṛtiryatastato vikalpa utpadyamānaḥ kṛtaka iti svākārābhinnaḥ sa kṛtakavyāvṛttameva śabdasvalakṣaṇaṃ pratipadyate na tvanitya iti tathā nityo na bhavatītyanenāpi dvāreṇa prabodhitāyā evānityavāsanāyāḥ sāmarthyaṃ yattato vikalpa utpadyamāno'nitya iti svākārābhinnaṃ nityavyāvṛttameva śabdasvalakṣaṇaṃ pratipadyate na tu kṛtaka iti tena buddhibhedo bhavati yataśca bādhyamānatvād vikalpapratibhāsyartho bāhyo na bhavatyato vāsanāvaśādeva bāhyāvabhāso vikalpastena vikalpasya bāhyarūpa eva pratibhāsamānorthaḥ svākāra ucyate na tu svākāre bāhyāropaḥ sādṛśyāt yadāha nāmanimittaprakaraṇe Pramāṇavārtika 3: 12. sārūpyād bhrāntito vṛttirarthe cet syānna sarvadā deśabhrāntiśca na jñāne tulyamutpattito dhiyaḥ tathāvidhāyā bāhyārthapratibhāsāyā iti etena yaducyate yadvāhyātyantavisadṛśasya svākārasya tādrūpyagrahaṇantadanyanivṛttikṛtasādṛśyaparaṃ yathā ghaṭavisadṛśopi paṭo vṛkṣābhāvaviśiṣṭo'vadhāryamāṇo yamapyavṛkṣa iti ghaṭasadṛśovadhāryate vṛkṣavyāvṛtterghaṭapaṭayostulyatvāt tathā vikalpaviṣayo'tyantaṃ vāme visadṛśopi vāme'vadhāryate'nyanivṛttikṛtasārūpya grahaṇāditi tadapāstaṃ svahetuta eva bāhyābhāsāyā vikalpabuddherutpatteḥ na cāsadṛśānāmanyanivṛttyā sādṛśyaṃ kriyate tatra tasyā bhedābhedasādṛśyakaraṇe'kiñcitkaratvāt na cānyanivṛttiḥ sadṛśī vidyate sadṛśānāmapi kathamanyanivṛttyā sādṛśyaṃ kriyate svarūpeṇaiva sādṛśyāt nāpi pūrvaṃ svākārapratibhāsaḥ paścāt tatrānyanivṛttikṛtasādṛśyagrahaṇaparo bāhyāropaḥ pratibhāsate na hi marīcikāyāṃ pūrvaṃ svarūpāpratibhāse sati sādṛśyagrahaṇahetuko jalāropaḥ sambhavati bāhyāropācca vinaṣṭatvādeva na sāmānyasya karmaṇā sambandhaḥ sākṣāt nāpi karmadvāreṇa pāramparyeṇa dravyasambandhosyāsambandhāt kāraṇānna sāmānyaṃ pācakādyabhidhānapratyayasya hetuḥ asambaddhamapi heturiti cedāha sāmānyamiti karmasāmānyanna karmaṇi samavetantasyāsattvāt karmābhāvādeva karttari pācake pāramparyeṇāpi samavetam ataḥ sambaddhasambandhopyasya sāmānyasya dravyeṇa saha nāsti anyathetyasambaddhasyāpi jñānādihetutve sthityabhāvācca karmaṇa ityādi yaduktaṃ tamatītetyādinā pakṣāntaramāśaṃkate atītaṃ yadvinaṣṭaṃ anāgataṃ yad bhaviṣyati karma tayoriti śabdajñānayoḥ karmāpyatītānāgatamasat jñānābhidhānayornimittamiti sambandhaḥ kiṃ kāraṇaṃ tayorityādi tayorjñānābhidhānayoḥ asatītyādinā vyācaṣṭe upākhyāyate prakāśyate vastvanayetyupākhyārthakriyāśaktiḥ sā nirgatā yasmādasatastattathoktaṃ asad yasmādarthakriyāśaktivikalaṃ tadevaṃbhūtaṃ kathaṃ śabdajñānayornimittaṃ syādityarthaḥ athāsatopi hetutvamiṣyate tadā tasya vastutvameva syānnāsattvaṃ kiṅkāraṇamityāha kāryetyādi lakṣaṇaśabdaḥ svabhāvavacanaḥ taditi tasmāt atītaṃ pracyutarūpaṃ anāgatamasaṃprāptarūpaṃ karmaṇaḥ sakāśādanyacca vyaktyādikaṃ jñānābhidhānayornimittatvena neṣṭaṃ sāmānyavādinā vyaktiḥ karmāśrayo dravyaṃ ādiśabdāt saṃketavāsanā tatparipākayorgrahaṇaṃ te iti śabdajñāne tathā cetyanvayinoḥ pācakādiśabdajñānayoranimittatve sati na jātisiddhiḥ caśabdāt nityaṃ sattvamasattvamvā śabdajñānayoḥ syāt kasmānna jātisiddhirityāha tasyā ityādi tasyā jāterabhinnasya jñānasyābhidhānasya ca nimittatveneṣṭatvāt yathā ca pācakādiviṣaye te animitte pravarttete tathā gavādāvapīti kena nibandhanena jātiḥ kalpyeta śaktirityādinā pakṣāntaramāśaṃkate karmāśrayasya dravyasya śaktiḥ śabdagrahaṇamupalakṣaṇaṃ pācakādi jñānasyāpi śaktirnimittaṃ netyādinā pratiṣedhati na pācakādiśaktiḥ pācakādiśabdanimittaṃ kiṅkāraṇaṃ śakterdravyāvyatirekeṇa dravyavadevānanvayādananvayinaścārthasyānvayijñānābhidhānaṃ prati nimittatvānabhyupagamāt abhyupagame vā jātikalpanāyā nirnibandhanatvaprasaṅgāt bhinnaiva śaktiriti cedāha na hītyādi na hi dravyādanyaiva śaktiryadi syāttadā tasyā ekaśakteḥ pākādyarthakriyāsūpayogena kāraṇena dravyasya śaktyādhārasyānupayogitvaprasaṅgāt tasyāṃ pākādinirvarttikāyāṃ śaktau tasya dravyasyopayogaḥ evamapi pāramparyeṇa pākādau dravyamupayuktaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ kimityādi si ddhā nta vā dī arthāntarabhūtayā śaktyā na kiñcit prayojanaṃ tathā hi pākādinirvarttikāyāṃ prathamāyāṃ śaktau dravyaṃ yayā śaktyopayujyeta sāpi śaktiryadi vyatiriktā'bhyupagamyeta tadā pākādinirvarttikāyāṃ śaktau dravyasyopayogāya śaktyantarasya dravyād vyatirekiṇo'bhyupagame'tiprasaṅgāt tasyāmapi śaktāvupayogāyāparā vyatiriktā śaktiḥ kalpanīyā tatrāpyaparetyanavasthā syādityarthaḥ tasmādantareṇa vyatiriktaṃ śaktiṃ dravyameva prathamāyāṃ pākādinirvirttikāyāṃ śaktāvupayujyata iti vācyaṃ evaṃ ca dravyasyopayoge śaktāviṣyamāṇe taddravyamarthakriyāyāṃ pākādilakṣaṇāyāmevopayujyata iti kinneṣyate dravyasyārthakriyāyāścāntarāle kimanarthikayā śaktyā kalpitayā yata evantasmāt pākādyarthakriyāśaktirityanena dravyamevocyate kimbhūtantatkāryaṃ tatpākādi kāryaṃ yasya tacca dravyaṃ vyaktyantaraṃ nānvetīti kṛtvā tato dravyāt pācakaḥ pācaka ityanvayī śabdo na syājjñānañca śabdagrahaṇaṃ tūpalakṣaṇaṃ 161-62 pācakādiṣu dravyeṣu pācakatvādisāmānyamasti tadanvayi śabdajñānanibandhanamiti cedāha sāmānyamityādi sāmānyaṃ pācakatvādi yadīṣyate tadā pākādinirvarttanaśaktyavasthāyāḥ prāgeva dravyasyotpattisamakāla eva dravyasamavetantad bhavedityarthaḥ tathā ca tadaharjātopi bālaḥ pācakādijñānābhidhānaviṣayaḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ no cet prāgeva bhavet tadā paścādapi na bhavet tasya dravyasyāviśeṣāt astyeva sarvakālaṃ dravye pācakatvādi kintu prāganabhivyaktamato na śabdajñānayornimittamityata āha vyaktamiti prāgevābhivyaktambhavedityarthaḥ sattādivat yathā sattādravyatvādi yāvaddravyabhāvi arthakriyāyāśca prāgeva yogyadeśāvasthitaṃ dravyaṃ athāpītyādinā vyācaṣṭe satyarthe jātyāśraye tatsamavāyasya sāmānyasamavāyasyākādācitkatvāt sarvakālabhāvitvāt etadeva draḍhayannāha yāvanti hītyādi arthe jātyāśraye samavāyadharmāṇi sambandhayogyāni tāni sāmānyāni asyārthasya ya utpādaḥ tena saha samavayanti asmin sāmānyāśraya iti vibhaktivipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ utpādasamakālameva dravyeṇa saha sambadhyata iti yāvat iti samayaḥ sā mā nya vā di naḥ siddhāntaḥ yadāho dyo ta ka raḥ prāggotvānnāsau gaurnāpyagauriti kiṅkāraṇam abhāve tau viśeṣaṇapratyayau na ca viśeṣaṇapratyayau viśeṣyasambandhamantareṇa bhavato na ca prāg gotvayogād vastu vidyate na cāvidyamānaṃ gauriti vā'gauriti vā śakyate vyapadeṣṭuṃ yadaiva vastūtpadyate tadaiva gotvenābhisambadhyata iti tathā na satassattāsambandho nāsataḥ yadaiva ca vastu tadaiva sattayā sambadhyata iti Nyāyavārtīka. atha siddhāntamatikramya paścād bhāvitvaṃ sāmānyasya kalpyate tadā tadvyatikrame siddhāntavyatikrame tasya sāmānyasyāśrayasya dravyasya paścādapyaviśeṣānna tatsamavāyaḥ syāt tena sāmānyena samavāyo na syāt yathā phalaikasvabhāvasyāpi raktatā prāṅ na bhavati paścācca bhavati tadvatpuruṣasya pācakatvādisāmānyamityata āha tatsambandhītyādi tatsambandhisvabhāvavaiguṇyāt pācakatvādisāmānyasambandhisvabhāvavaiguṇyāt sa iti sāmānyasamavāyaḥ tasyeti puṃsaḥ na hyaviguṇe svabhāve sthitasya tatsambandho na bhavet tatraiva ca sāmānyasamavāyaviguṇe svabhāve sthitasya dravyasya paścāt sāmānyasamavāyo bhaviṣyatīti duranvayandurbodhametat phalasyāpyāmrādeḥ pūrvaṃ paścācca yadyekasvabhāvatā tatrāpi tulyaṃ codyaṃ sāmānyasambaddhameva tadā dravyaṃ kriyopakārāpekṣantu sāmānyaṃ vyanakti 162-63 sā ca prāṅnāstīti na prāk sāmānyābhivyaktirityata āha kriyopakāretyādi pākādilakṣaṇā kriyā tatkṛto ya upakārastadapekṣasya sāmānyaṃ prati vyañjakatve'bhyupagamyamāne tasya dravyasyākṣaṇikatvādavikāriṇonapekṣā sahakāriṇaṃ prati atha vikriyeta tadāpyatiśayesya dravyasya kṣaṇikatvamāpadyate kṣaṇikatvāccotpādānantaraṃ dhvaṃsinaḥ kutaḥ kriyā yena tadupakārāpekṣaṃ jātervyañjakaṃ syāt karmopakāretyādinā vyācaṣṭe adhiśrayaṇādilakṣaṇo vyāpāraḥ karma tatkṛta upakārotiśayastamapekṣya sthirasvabhāvasya pūrvasvabhāvādacalatonatiśayāt svabhāvāntarānupādānāt aviśeṣādhāyini karmaṇi kāpekṣā naiva atiśaye vā dravyasya kriyākṛtebhyupagamyamāne'tiśayādhāyakasya karmaṇaḥ kṣaṇikatvāt tasyāpyupakāryasya dravyasya svabhāvabhūtenānyenātiśayenotpattavyaṃ yadi kriyākṛto'tiśayo na svabhāvabhūto dravyasya tadarthāntarasya karaṇād dravyaṃ naivopakṛtaṃ syāt tasmād yathākriyākṣaṇaṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ svabhāvabhūtasyānyānyasyātiśayotpattestadapi dravyaṃ devadattādi kṣaṇikaṃ syāt tata iti kṣaṇikatvāt svotpattisthānavināśinaḥ svasminnevotpattideśe vināśinaḥ puṃsaḥ kṛtaḥ pākalakṣaṇā kriyā yadapekṣantat kriyāsāpekṣaṃ pācakādidravyasāmānyasya vyañjakaṃ syāta nanu ca prathamādikriyākṣaṇadvāreṇa dravyasya kṣaṇikatvaṃ kriyā'bhāve ca kathaṃ kṣaṇikatvamiti cet na yataḥ kriyāsambandhotpannānāṃ kṣaṇānāmanyasyāḥ kriyāyāssāmānyābhivyañjikāyā abhāvādityarthaḥ tasmāt sthitametad yathā vastubhūtā jātirnāstīti 163-64 kathantarhītyādi paraḥ yathetyādi si ddhā nta vā dī yathā-pācakādiṣu pācakatvādisāmānyannāsti tathā prasādhitamatha ca tatra pravarttete anvayinau jñānaśabdau tathānyatrāpyantareṇa sāmānyantau bhivaṣyataḥ tadvadityādi paraḥ teṣviti pācakādiṣu sāmānyamvinā kathamanvayinorjñānaśabdayorvṛttiriti tatonvayajñānaśabdavṛtteḥ pācakādiṣvapi pācakatvādisāmānyamastīti cintitametadanantaraṃ tathā teṣu pācakatvādi sāmānyaṃ sa na sambhavatīti yadyanvayi rūpannāsti tatkimidānīmanimitte te śabdajñāne syātāṃ netyādi si ddhā nta vā dī astyeva tayornimittaṃ yat pareṇeṣyate tasya pratikṣepaḥ tadevāha kintarhītyādi vastubhūtaṃ sāmānyambāhyatatvaṃ nimitte te na bhavataḥ kintarhi tayornimittamityata āha yathāsvamityādi yo ya ātmīyo vāsanāprabodhastasmādanvayino vikalpasyotpattiḥ tato vikalpotpatteḥ sakāśād yathāvikalpaṃ śabdā bhavanti na punarvikalpābhidhānayorvastusattā anvayipadārthasattāsamāśraya ityuktaprāyametata avaśyaṃ caitadeṣṭavyaṃ tathā hi yathāsvaṃ samavāyavāsanāvaśāt siddhāntāśrayeṇa jñānavāsanānurodhād virodhirūpasamāveśena parasparaviruddharūpādhyāropeṇa pra dhā na kāryamī śva ra kāryamahetukaṃ samvṛttimātraṃ jagadityevaṃ sarvabhedeṣvanvayinostayoriti jñānābhidhānayoḥ aparāparadarśanepīti parasparabhinnānāmarthānāndarśanepi na ca tatreti pradhānādikāryatvena parasparaviruddhena rūpeṇa kalpiteṣvartheṣu tannibandhanaḥ śabdajñānayornibandhanaḥ kasmānnāstītyāha parasparavirodhinorityādi aniyamenetyādi paraḥ sarvaṃ sarvatrānvayi jñānamabhidhānaṃ ca syāt etadeva sādhayannāha na hyanimittamityādi nanu yathāsvaṃ vāsanāprabodhād vikalpotpatterityādinā tayoranimittatvaṃ pratiṣiddhamityanavakāśameva codyaṃ evammanyate āntarameva nimittantayoriṣyate tasya ca nimittasya kenacidāsattiviprakarṣābhāvāt sarvatra sarvavikalpahetutvaṃ syāditi na hyanimitte bhavadityatra bāhyanimittābhāvādanimittamiti draṣṭavyaṃ nānimitte iti si ddhā nta vā dī aviśiṣṭanimitte na bhavata ityarthaḥ ata evāha vāsanāviśeṣanimittatvāditi yathābhūtadarśanadvārāyātā vāsanā sā tatraivādhyavasitatadbhāvamvikalpaṃ janayati na sarvatreti samudāyārthaḥ tathābhūtamityanvayi rūpaṃ na cāsati tasminnanvayini bāhye nimitte vikalpena na bhavitavyambhavitavyameva tadeva suptetyādinā sādhayati suptaśca taimirikaśca tābhyāmupalabdheṣvartheṣu gavādiṣu keśamakṣikādiṣu ca yathākramaṃ abhāveṣu śaśaviṣāṇādiṣu samavāyavāsanā yathā svaṃ siddhāntaṃ saṃketavāsanā tadbalenāropitarūpaviśeṣe pradhānakāryādiṣu tathā vikalpotpatteranvayino vikalpasyotpatteḥ na hyeteṣu yathokteṣu bāhyamanvayi rūpamasti svapnatimiropalabdhānāmevāsattvāt teṣāṃ cāsattvaṃ tṛtīye paricchede 3 85 pratipādayiṣyate siddhāntasamāropitasya tu parasparavirodhinoryugapadekatretyādinā pratipāditamevāsattvaṃ na ca te vikalpāḥ svapnādyupalabdheṣvasatsu vastubhūtānvayirūpamantareṇāpyutpadyaṃta iti sarvatrārthāḥ sarvākārā bhavantyapi tu pratiniyatā eva niyamahetuṃ cāha vibhāgenaivetyādi tathaivopalabdhānāmiti vibhāgenopalabdhānāṃ vibhāgenaiva vikalpanāt suptatimirāvasthāyāntāvad bhrāntajñānārūḍhānāmarthānāṃ vibhāgenopalambhaḥ siddhāntāropitānāmapi yathāsvaṃ siddhāntaśravaṇakāle śaśaviṣāṇamityādiṣvapi śaśaviṣāṇaṃ bandhyāsuta iti vyavahāravyutpattikāle'nāditvād vyavahāravāsanāyāḥ uktaṃ cātretyādi ekapratyamarśārthajñānādyekārthasādhana 1 75 ityatra ekapratyamarśārthajñānādyekārthasādhana api ca yathā dhavakhadirādayaḥ parasparabhinnāstathā gavādayaḥ tatra tulye bhede kasmād vṛkṣatvaṃ dhavādiṣveva varttate na gavādiṣviti pṛṣṭena pareṇaitadeva vaktavyaṃ bhāvaśaktireva sā dhavādīnāṃ yena ta eva vṛkṣatvaṃ prati pratyāsannā na gavādaya iti tadā tulye bhedye yayā pratyāsattyā bhāvaśaktilakṣaṇayā jātiḥ kvacit svāśrayābhimate'rtharāśau prasarppati vyāpya varttate saiva bhāvaśaktiranvayiśabdajñānanibandhanamastu kiṃ sāmānyena kalpitena tena yaducyate viṣayeṇa hi buddhīnāṃ vinā notpattiriṣyate viśeṣādanyadicchanti sāmānyantena tad dhruvaṃ tā hi tena vinotpannā mithyā syurviṣayādṛte na tvanyena vinā vṛttissāmānyasyeha duṣyatīti tadapāstaṃ na hi yathā sāmānyamantareṇa keṣucit sāmānyavṛttiriṣyate tathā sāmānyamvinā sāmānyabuddhiriṣyatāmiti parobhyupagamaṃ kāryate yena tā hi tena vinotpannā mithyā syuriti parasyottaraṃ syāt kevalaṃ yathā parasya sāmānyamantareṇa keṣucit padārthaṣu yayā pratyāsattyā sāmānyavṛttiḥ saiva bhrāntānvayijñānaśabdanimittamastu kiṃ sāmānyenetyayamarthotra vivakṣita iti na kaściddoṣaḥ tasmāt sthitametad vyāvṛtterevaikatvādhyavasāyād bhāveṣvanvayo nānyasyeti 164-65 atra sāṃ khyaḥ prāha na nivṛttimityādi bhāvānvayo bhāvānāmekarūpatvaṃ apara iti vastubhūtaḥ tadekasya bījasya yatkāryantadanyasya pṛthivyāderna syāt kasmāt tayorbījapṛthivyoratyantabhedataḥ 165-66 yadyeta ityādinā vyācaṣṭe eṣāmiti bhāvānāṃ yathā bījādekādīnāmekamaṃkurākhyaṃ kāryaṃ yo hītyādinā tadeva sādhayati yo hi tasya bījasyāṃkurajanana svabhāvo na hi sonyasya pṛthivyāderasti yosti buddhyāropito vyāvṛttilakṣaṇo na sa janakaḥ kasmād vyatirekasyānyavyāvṛttilakṣaṇasya niḥsvabhāvatvāt tasmād bījasvalakṣaṇameva janakaṃ yacca janakarūpantadeva vastu tajjanakaṃ cetyaṅkurajanakaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ aparaveti pṛthivyādau aparaṃ pṛthivyādikamaṃkuraṃ janayet sa hītyādi hi śabda evakārārthaḥ tasyeti bījasya anyasya pṛthivyādeḥ sa pṛthivyādistenāṃkurajananena bījasvabhāvena tato bījādabhinnaḥ syāt ityastisvabhāvānvayaḥ tena kecit svabhāvabhedepi prakṛtyaikakāryakāriṇa indriyādivadityayuktamuktamiti Śloka, Ākṛti 37, 38 yadītyādinā si ddhā nta vā dī ātmaikatrāpīti kāraṇakalāpasya yenābhinnenātmanā janakatvamiṣyate sa ātmā teṣāṃ kāraṇānāmmadhye ekatrāpi kāraṇestīti tenaikena kāryaṃ kṛtamiti kṛtvā vyarthāḥ syuḥ sahakāriṇaḥ nanu vyāvṛttivādinopyantyāvasthāyāṃ sarveṣāṃ janakatvāt kāraṇāntaravaiyarthyaṃ naitadasti samuditānāmeva teṣāntādṛśaṃ sāmarthyaṃ kṣaṇikānāṃ hetupratyayāyattasannidhitvāt parasya tu nityavādinaḥ sadā tad rūpamastīti bhavetkāraṇāntarāṇāmānarthakyaṃ ata evoktamekatrāpi sostīti kāraṇāntaravikalāvasthāyāmapītyarthaḥ yadītyādinā vyācaṣṭe anekaḥ padārtho yadyekasvabhāvatvādekasya kāryasya kārakaḥ janakaḥ sa teṣāṃ kāraṇābhimatānāmabhinno janakaḥ svabhāva ekakāraṇasannidhānepyastiṃ tataśca sarvasyāmavasthāyārmavaikalyāt kāraṇasya yatra tatrāvasthitirekopi janakaḥ syāt 166-67 etadeva draḍhayannāha yasmādityādi ekasminnapi bījādau sannihite nāpaityabhinnaṃ tatkāryajananaṃ sāmānyarūpaṃ viśeṣā vyaktibhedā apāyinaḥ na hi tasyā bhinnasya kāryajananasvabhāvasya bījādarthāntarepi pṛthivyādau viśeṣosti kiṅkāraṇam viśeṣe satyabhedahāneḥ sa hyabhinno janakābhimataḥ svabhāvastatrāpi bījepi kevalestīti naikasya sthitāvapi tasyetyabhinnasya rūpasya janakābhimatasyāpāyo vināśosti traiguṇyasya sarvātmanā sarvatra sarvadā sattvāt ye viśeṣā avasthābhedāsteṣāṃ sahasthitiniyamābhāvāt syādapāyaḥ etaccābhyupagamyoktaṃ anyathā nityādavasthāntaravyatiriktānāṃ viśeṣāṇāmapi kathamapāyaḥ na ca te janakā iti viśeṣāḥ kasmānneṣṭā ityāha sahakāriṇāmityādi tasmādekasminnapi bījādau sthite janakasyātmanaḥ sthānāt asthāyina iti viśeṣasya ekasthitāvapīti bījāderanyatamasya sthitāvapi kāryotpattiḥ syāt na ca vyāpyadharmaniścayādeva iyatā gamyagamakayoḥ svarūpandarśitaṃ nivarttyanivarttakayorapi svarūpamāha tasyetyādi ayamiti vyāpako dharmaḥ svayaṃ nivṛttau satyāṃ tasya vyāpyasya nivarttakaḥ tasyetyādinā vyācaṣṭe ayaṃ vyāpako dharmaḥ svayannivarttamānastasya vyāpyasya nivarttaka iti sambandhaḥ kiṅkāraṇaṃ yasmādevaṃ hyasyāyaṃ sādhyo dharmo vyāpakaḥ siddho bhavati yadyasya vyāpakasyābhāve vyāpyo na bhavet taditi vākyopanyāse anenānantaroktenānuvarttyānuvarttakabhāvasya nivarttyanivarttakabhāvasya ca pradarśanena dvividhasyāpi sādharmyavato vaidharmyavataśca sādhanaprayogasya gamakalakṣaṇaṃ sādhyasādhakatvalakṣaṇamuktamveditavyaṃ tadvyācaṣṭe dvividho hītyādi yathāhureke iti nai yā yi kāḥ sādharmyavāneva hi prayogonvayī vaidharmyavāneva ca vyatirekī nanu sādharmyaprayoge pakṣadharmatvamanvayaśceti tathā vaidharmyaprayogepi pakṣadharmatvaṃ vyatirekaśceti dvirūpantarhi liṅgamprāptamityāha nānayorityādi anayorityanvayavyatirekiṇorhetvorvastutaḥ paramārthato na kaścid bhedaḥ dvayorapyanvayavyatirekavattvāt anyatra saṃyogabhedāt tasmāttāvevānvayavyatirekau kadācitsādharmyaprayogeṇa pratipādyete kadācid vaidharmyaprayogeṇeti prayogamātrambhidyate na tvarthaḥ kiṃ kāraṇaṃ yasmāt sādharmyeṇāpi hi prayoge'rthāt sāmarthyāt sādhyavipakṣāddhetorvyāvṛttirvaidharmyantasya gatiḥ tadeva sāmarthyamāha asatītyādi tasminniti vaidharmye evaṃ hi sādhyenānvito hetuḥ syād yadi sādhyābhāve na bhavet tathā vaidharmya iti vaidharmyaprayoge tasminnityanvaye yadi hi sādhyena hetoranvayaḥ syāt tadāyaṃ sādhyanivṛttau nivartteta etacca vya ti re ka ci ntā yāmvakṣyāmaḥ 194-95 anityatve yathā kāryaṃ anitya eva kṛtakatvaṃ etaccānvayina udāharaṇaṃ akāryamvā avināśinīti vyatirekiṇa udāharaṇaṃ tenāyamartho bhavati avināśini vināśābhāve sati akāryaṃ kṛtakatvanna bhavati tadevāha anenetyādi anayorityanvayavyatirekiṇoḥ yatkiñciditi sarvopasaṃhāreṇa vyāptikathanenārthānnityād vyāvṛttiḥ kṛtakatvasyokteti vyatirekamatiḥ śabdaśca kṛtaka iti pakṣadharmakathanaṃ pakṣaḥ kasmānnocyata ityāha kṛtakasyetyādi anityatvena vyāptaṃ kṛtakatvaṃ yadā śabdena kathitantadā niyamena svaṃ vyāpakaṃ sannidhāpayatīti sāmarthyādevānityaḥ śabda iti bhavati tasmānnāvaśyamityādi iheti sādharmyaprayoge vaidharmyavantaṃ prayogamāha vyatirekepītyādi etaccākāryamvā 'vināśītyetasya vivaraṇaṃ ihāpi na pratijñāvacanaṃ yasmāt siddhasvabhāvatayā niścitayā nityasvabhāvatayā hetubhūtayā tadabhāva siddheḥ pūrvavaditi sādharmyaprayogavat nanvatra vaidharmyaprayoge'nvayo nokta ityāha anvayastvityādi anvayamantareṇa vaidharmyasyānupapattirarthāpattiḥ kiṅkāraṇaṃ na hītyādi yasmādatadātmaniyatasyānityasvabhāve'pratibaddhasya tannivṛttāvanityatvanivṛttau nivṛttiryuktā yata evantasmāt svayantādātmyatadutpattibhyāṃ hetoḥ sādhye niyamaṃ pramāṇena prasādhya sādhyanivṛttyā janakāddhetoranyo vināśasya hetuḥ tasmāt svabhāvādanabandhaḥ tadayamatra samudāyārthaḥ mudgaravyāpārānantaraṃ dvayaṃ pratīyate ghaṭanivṛttiḥ kapālaṃ ca tathaite vināśarūpatayā pratīyete tatra ghaṭanivṛtternīrūpatvenākāryatvāditi vakṣyati tatkāryatvena tu pratītibhrāntireva kāryatve vāsyā na ghaṭanivṛttirūpatvaṃ syāt ghaṭasambandhitvena kṛtakatvāt vināśarūpatayā ca na pratītiḥ syāt ghaṭasya sattvāt kapālasyāpi mudgarakāryatve satyapi vināśarūpatā ghaṭasyānivṛttatvāditi ca vakṣyati tataśca kathamasya vināśarūpatayā pratītiḥ nirhetuke tu vināśe svarasato nivarttamāna eva ghaṭo mudgarādisahakārī kapālajanakatvena sadṛśakṣaṇānārambhakatvāt mudgaravyāpārānantaraṃ ghaṭanivṛtteḥ kapālasya ca sadbhāvāttayorvināśarūpatayā vināśasya ca sahetukatvena mandamatīnāmavasāyo yujyata eva mudgaravyāpārānantaraṃ santānavicchedāt tatkathaṃ nirhetukavināśābhyupagamavādināṃ pratītibādhā codyata iti etamevārthamāha na hītyādi naśyanta iti yeṣāntāvat kṛtakānāṃ nāśo dṛśyate te vinaśyantaḥ tadbhāve vinaśvarasvabhāve svarūpajanakādanyatra hetumapekṣate kutaḥ svahetoreva vinaśvarāṇāṃ nivṛttidharmāṇāṃ bhāvāt yataśca naśvarasvabhāvaṃ pratyanapekṣatā bhāvānāntasmād yaḥ kaścid kṛtakaḥ sa hetusāpekṣatve hi ghaṭādīnāmmadhye keṣāñcinnityatāpi syāt yeṣāṃ nāśakāraṇamasannihitaṃ vāhulyāt vināśakāraṇānāṃ na kvacidasannidhānamiti cedāha yenetyādi taddhetoriti vināśahetosteṣāmapi pratyabhijñānandṛṣṭaṃ tasmādanaikāntikametat tathā kṣaṇikepi karmaṇi prayoge dṛśyate tena prayujyamānatvādityapi heturanaikāntika eva yadapi kiñcilliṅgaṃ śabdasyaikatvasādhanāyopādīyate uttarā darśinopi idānīntanena ca rūpeṇa vastvavasthitanna prāktanena avasthite ca rūpe prāktanarūpasyānavasthānameva vināśaḥ yathā vṛddhāvasthāyāmbālarūpasya prāktanañca rūpamatītajñānakarma idānīntanaṃ ca rūpamaparokṣamatha ca bālādyavasthāyāṃ dṛṣṭaḥ puruṣo vṛddhādyavasthāyāṃ pratyabhijñāyata iti kathamatītajñānakarmatā'parokṣate ekādhikaraṇe pratibhāsete kathaṃ vā'parokṣa evārthotītajñānaviśiṣṭatayā vyañjakabhedata iti Kumārila. tadapāstaṃ yato dhvaniviśeṣa eva varṇṇa ucyate tena drutoccāritā dhvaniviśeṣā drutā gavyaktirucyate madhyoccāritā madhyagavyaktiḥ vilambitoccāritā dhvaniviśeṣā vilamvitā gavyaktiḥ na tu vyañjekebhyo dhvanibhyonyo gakāraḥ pratibhāsate gakāro gakāra iti teṣu nāmasāmyameva kevalaṃ pratīyate tathā hrasvadīrghaplutādiṣu naikākāraḥ yato dhvaniviśeṣā eva mātrākālaṃ prayujyamānā hrasvokāro bhavati tathāpare dhvaniviśeṣā dvimātrākālaṃ prayujyamānā dīrgha ākāro bhavati trimātrākālaṃ prayujyamānā dhvaniviśeṣāḥ pluto bhavati tena hrasvadīghraplutānāṃ svabhāvabheda eva pratibhāsate na tvakāro'bhinnasteṣu pratibhāsate akāra eva tu mātrādikālamuccāryamāṇo yathākramaṃ hrasvadīrghaplutāḥ pratīyanta iti śabdamātrameva kevalaṃ tena yaducyate svato hrasvādibhedastu nityavāde virudhyate sarvadā yasya sadbhāvaḥ sa kathaṃ mātrikaḥ svayaṃ tasmāduccāraṇantasya mātrākālaṃ pratīyatāṃ dvimātramvā trimātramvā na śabdo mātrikaḥ svayamiti Śloka-Sphoṭavāda 50, 51 tadapi nirastaṃ hrasvadīrghapluteṣvakārokāra ityanuyāyinorjñānābhidhānayorapravṛtteḥ athāpi syāt pūrvottarakālabhāvinyoḥ pratītyornāmasāmyādekaviṣayatvamiti ata āha pratītyādi pūrvottarayorakārapratītyoḥ pratibhāsabhedaḥ pūrvottararūpatayā svabhāvabhedo drutamadhyavilamvitādibhedena tasmin pratītipratibhāsasvabhāvabhedepi akārapratītirakārapratītirityevaṃ nāmasāmyādekaviṣayatvamayuktaṃ kiṃ kāraṇaṃ ghaṭādiṣvapi prasaṅgāt yā pūrvā ghaṭapratītiryā ca paścād anyaghaṭapratītista- yorapi ghaṭapratītirghaṭapratītiriti nāmasāmyādekaviṣayatvaṃ syāt tathā caiko ghaṭaḥ sarvatra prāpnoti tatra ghaṭādāvekatvasādhane dṛṣṭavirodho ghaṭādīnāmanekatvasya dṛṣṭatvāt tasmāt tatrāsādhanamekatvasyeti cet ihāpi varṇṇeṣvapyekatvasādhane dṛṣṭavirodhābhāvaḥ kena pramāṇena siddhaḥ atrāpi karaṇānāṃ pratipuruṣaṃ bhedena bhedaḥ siddha eva lūnapunarjāteṣu keśeṣviva sādṛśyādekatvādhyavasāya iti yāvat nāmasāmyādityayaṃ heturanaikāntika ityāha yāvadityādi tathābhidheyateti akārapratītyerakārapratītirityevaṃ nāmasāmyenābhidheyatā arthābhedena viṣayaikatvena vyāptyā na sādhyate tāvat sandigdho vyatirekaḥ nāmasāmyaṃ ca syād bhedaśceti kiñca pratikaraṇabhedaṃ puruṣabhedena karaṇabhedaṃ prati bhinnasvabhāvaḥ śabdaḥ śrutau śrotravijñāne niviśamānaḥ samārohan yadaikaḥ sādhyate kinna ghaṭādayopyekarūpāssādhyante tepi sādhyantāṃ viśeṣopi vā vācyaḥ ekatvepi śabdasya vyañjakabhedāt pratibhāsabheda iti cedāha tatrāpītyādi tatrāpi bhinne ghaṭādau śakyamevaṃ vyañjakabhedāt pratibhāsabheda iti pratyavasthātuṃ 266 kiñca kāraṇānāṃ samagrāṇāṃ vyāpārāt parispandādilakṣaṇānniyamena śabdasyaivaupalabdhitaḥ kāraṇāt kāryatvamprāptaṃ kiṃ kāraṇaṃ vyañjake hetau tadasambhavāt niyamena vyaṅgyasyopalambhāsambhavāt na hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe vyāpṛteṣu karaṇeṣu na hi kadācicchabdānupalabdhiḥ kintūpalabdhireva na cāvaśyaṃ vyañjakavyāpārorthamupalambhayati grāhayati kiṃ kāraṇaṃ kvacid ghaṭādiśūnye deśe prakāśe pradīpādilakṣaṇe satyapi ghaṭādyanupalabdheḥ tasmādavikalavijñānotpādasahakārikāraṇasya puṃsaḥ seyaṃ śabdasya tadvyāpārāt kāraṇavyāpārānniyamenopalabdhistadudbhave karaṇavyāpārācchabdasyotpattau satyāṃ syāt tataśca janya eva śabdo na vyaṅgyaḥ nanu pūrvaṃ jananamātreṇa kārakaṃ jñānajananayogyatvenotpādakantu vyañjakamevetyuktaṃ tena tālvādīnāṃ vyañjakatvameva yuktaṃ naiṣa doṣo yataḥ kāryamātramabhipretya jananamātreṇa kārakaṃ jñānajananayogyatvena tu vyañjaka ityuktaṃ na tu dṛśyakāryāpekṣayā tathā hyavikalasahakārikāraṇasya puṃsaḥ pradīpādijanako niyamena pradīpāderupalambhakaḥ kārako na vyañjaka ityadoṣaḥ atha punaḥ karaṇaṃśabdasyākarttṛ tasyākartuḥ karaṇasya vyāpāreṇa tatsiddhyayogāt śabdasya siddhyayogāt vyāpinaḥ śabdā nityāśca tato vyāpinityatvācchabdānāṃ vyañjakasya karaṇasya vyāpārāt sarvatropalabdhiḥ ghaṭādayastu na vyāpino nāpi nityāḥ tena te vyañjakavyāpāreṇa nāvaśyamupalabhyanta iti yadyevaṃ ka idānīṃ ghaṭādiṣu samāśvāsaḥ niścayaḥ yathā te na nityā nāpi vyāpina iti yāvatā tepi nityā vyāpinaśca bhavantu kathaṃ sarvadā nopalabhyanta iti cet etacchabdeṣvapi tulyaṃ yattatra pratividhānaṃ tad ghaṭādiṣvapi bhaviṣyati teṣāṃ ghaṭādīnāntathā vyāpinityatvenāniṣṭeriti cet śabdo vyāpinityatvena kimiṣṭaḥ kasmādiṣṭastatsamānadharmā ghaṭādisamānadharmā pratiṣiddhe ca vyāpinityatve prāgiti yatkiñcidetat ghaṭādīnāmityādi paraḥ kārakavyatirekeṇa vyañjakāntarasadbhāvādadoṣaḥ śabdena tulyatvaprasaṅgadoṣo nāsti vyañjakāntarameva darśayannāha prakāśo hītyādi prakāśo hyeṣāṃ ghaṭādīnāṃ vyañjako loke siddho na kulālādayaḥ kulālādīnāṃ vyañjakatve te kulālādayastādṛśā eva syuḥ yathā pradīpādayo na niyamena ghaṭamupalambhayanti kvacit prakāśepi ghaṭasyābhāvāt tathā kulālādayopi bhaveyuḥ na caivam atiśerate ca kulālādayaḥ kulālādivyāpāre sarvadā ghaṭāderbhāvāt tato vyañjakātiśayāt vyañjakād bhedena vṛtteḥ kārakā eva kulālādayaḥ kiṃ kāraṇam upakārakasya gatyantarābhāvāt kārakavyañjakatvavyatirekeṇa prakārāntarābhāvāt tatra vyañjakatve niṣiddhe pāriśeṣyāt kārakatvaṃ kulālādīnāṃ naivaṃ śabdasya karaṇamuktvānyad vyañjakāntaraṃ siddhaṃ yena karaṇameva śabdasya kārakaṃ kalpyeta tasmād ghaṭādivailakṣaṇyācchabdo vyaṅgya eva tadityādi siddhāntavādī tadetad vyañjakāntarasambhavanaṃ śabdepi tulyaṃ yasmāt tatrāpi śabde indriyayogyadeśatādibhyaḥ śrotrendriyācchrotrayogyadeśāvasthānāt ādiśabdāt manaskārācca karaṇānāmatiśayāt atiśaya eva kathamiti cedāha ghaṭādītyādi hyarthe caśabdaḥ ghaṭāderye kārakāḥ kulālādayaḥ samagrāsteṣāṃ yo dharmo niyamena svakāryārambhakatvantasya karaṇeṣu dṛṣṭeḥ tānyapi hi vyāpṛtāni śabdaṃ niyamena janayanti tasmāt tānyapi kulālādivat kārakāṇyeva yadi ca pradīpādikāraṇāni caiṣāṃ pradīpādīnāṃ vyañjakāni syuḥ yata evantasmānna vyaktiḥ śabdasya karaṇebhyaḥ kintūtpattireva bhavantī vā karaṇebhyaḥ sakāśād vyaktistridhā bhavet 1
